column1: # mapping_set_description: "Alignments between the Deliberation Ontology (DEL) and the Metagov Deliberation Interoperability Project (DIP) exported RDF terms. DIP URIs are provisional (pre-release)."

column5: DIP Statement (org.deliberation.statement) closely matches del:Contribution. DIP StatementRole values map onto DEL specializations: Evidence to del:Evidence, Refutation to del:attacks relations, Proposal and Decision to del:Position and del:Consensus contexts.
DIP Project (org.deliberation.project) is the container of one deliberative process, exported as schema:Project; DIP Phase corresponds to del:Stage but has no RDF export yet.
DIP Location (org.deliberation.location) is exported as schema:Place; del:Forum covers both physical and virtual deliberation spaces.

DIP Person (org.deliberation.person) is exported as schema:Person; del:Participant is broader, covering organizational and non-human agents. DIP additionally attributes content to a Generator (Participant, Host, or Algorithm), a pattern DEL currently expresses only for human participants via del:madeBy.
DIP madeBy ranges over Generator (participant, host, or algorithm), wider than del:madeBy which ranges over del:Participant.
Direct conceptual equivalent for threading of contributions.
Direct conceptual equivalent for the textual content of a contribution.
